articles.title: Payments firm OpenPayd targets year-end Nasdaq listing to fund U.S. expansion and acquisitions
articles.snippet: CEO Iana Dimitrova said OpenPayd aims to launch in the U.S. by April 2027 and is eyeing deals to add licenses and technology.

articles.title: Cathie Wood says smart investors need to start watching where AI agents spend money
articles.snippet: As AI agents evolve from answering questions to spending real money, investors and tech giants are scrambling to control the financial networks powering machine-driven commerce.

articles.title: Crypto's Sisyphean struggle
articles.snippet: Progress will effectively reset when the new Congress is sworn in, because key senators who quarterbacked the bill will not be on the ballot again, writes the Cato Institute's Ryan Chan-Wei.

articles.title: Bank group sues U.S. regulator over granting crypto trust charters
articles.snippet: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, accusing the regulator of overstepping its legal authority.

articles.title: BNY in talks with Kraken parent Payward over infrastructure partnership
articles.snippet: The potential agreement could span digital assets, custody, trading, payments and other financial-market infrastructure.
